changes: Increased ribbon panel MinHeight from 90 to 108 and button MinHeight from 66 to 76 to accommodate two-line button labels without clipping.
App no longer starts maximized — opens at 1280x768 centered on screen.
Replaced classic menu bar + toolbar with a Word 2024-style Ribbon UI with tabbed groups.

Ribbon tabs: File (connections, import/export, settings, exit), Home (new connection/query, close all, history, snippets, share profiles), Tools (compare data/schema, scheduler, GC), View (logs, diagnostics).
Each ribbon group has large icon buttons with labels and a group title below, separated by vertical dividers.
Tab headers use a modern flat style with accent-colored underline for the selected tab and hover effect.
No new dependencies added — built entirely with native WPF TabControl + MaterialDesign + MahApps styles.

Fixed cell values reverting on Apply Changes: DataGrid edit is now committed (CommitEdit) before generating SQL, and edit template uses UpdateSourceTrigger.PropertyChanged so DataRow always has current value.
Editing a cell without changing its value no longer marks the row as modified: CellEditEnding now compares old vs new value before marking.
Apply Changes button moved to Click handler in code-behind to ensure DataGrid edit commit before SQL execution.
Fixed column editability: NormalizeColumnEditability now runs BEFORE DataGrid binding so AutoGeneratingColumn sees correct ReadOnly flags, fixing double-click editing.
Enabled editing on tables without primary keys using all-column matching for UPDATE/DELETE WHERE clauses with original row values.
Fixed Delete Row context menu binding (PlacementTarget) so it works correctly across the ContextMenu visual tree.
Added row numbers in row headers for easier row selection (click header number to select entire row).
Softened no-PK warning from 'editing disabled' to 'updates use all-column matching'.
Row changes now call AcceptChanges() after successful save to track correct original values for subsequent edits.
Fixed false read-only behavior in table editor by normalizing DataTable column editability from real table metadata.
Data grid column edit mode now relies on normalized column flags so editable columns like claim_text are no longer blocked by provider schema metadata.
Enabled double-click editing in table cells with explicit BeginEdit behavior in the data grid.
Set NULL now handles read-only columns safely and shows an informative message instead of throwing exceptions.
Enhanced column headers with data-type icon + size metadata and set initial column widths with a 256px cap while keeping user resize flexibility.
Increased ribbon height and button sizing to prevent icon clipping in the main window.
Added Enter-to-save behavior in table data grid: pressing Enter commits the current edit and executes SQL for the current row immediately.
Implemented row-level persistence path for inline editor to apply single-row INSERT/UPDATE without waiting for full Apply Changes.
TreeView table interaction updated: double-click opens data tab and table row click/double-click no longer triggers default expand/collapse behavior.
Main window top area redesigned with menu bar (File/Edit/View/Favorites/Tools/Window/Help) and ribbon-style action buttons with larger icons.
Connection settings tabs (General/SSL/SSH) now use 15px vertical content padding for improved spacing.
Fixed connection tree infinite Loading by wiring TreeView expanded event to node IsExpanded lazy-load flow.
Added start.bat to kill running process, build DatabaseClient.slnx, and run src/DatabaseClient.App.
Configured application/window icon to use dbClient.ico and linked dbClient.png as app resource.
Fixed startup crash caused by invalid MaterialDesign PackIconKind in MainWindow toolbar.
Hardened GlobalExceptionHandler to avoid setting ErrorDialog owner before MainWindow is loaded.
Initial versioning system established.
Added versions.json for structured version log.
All Module 6 features complete: error panel, monitoring dashboard, diagnostics, CI/CD.
